LanguageData.RLEMake_ChemfuelFromAnimalCorpse.descrip:
Extracts organic matter from fresh corpses that have not yet begun to decompose to process them into bio-liquefied fuel. Since the bodies are not dissected, impurities mix in, resulting in lower efficiency compared to processing raw meat as fuel.
Product: Bio-liquefied fuel ×35

Human corpses can also be processed, but using human corpses for industrial product manufacturing is often considered an unethical issue and is explicitly punishable as a crime in many sectors. However, on the planet where you currently reside, such rules do not exist.
If you need equipment from the corpse, strip it before processing.
LanguageData.RLEMake_ChemfuelFromAnimalCorpse.label: Fresh corpses converted to fuel ×1 batch
